I visited the Fazyo Kollam outlet last week and had an extremely disappointing experience. The customer service was exceptionally poor. The staff ladies seemed completely unaware of the current collections or available stock, and they could not even guide me to where specific products were arranged. Instead of assisting customers, they were busy chatting, joking, and laughing among themselves right in front of us. It felt highly unprofessional and unwelcoming. I hope management takes immediate steps to train their staff on basic retail etiquette and product knowledge. Worst experience.

I recently did some shopping at Fazyo, Angamaly, and purchased a few dresses from there. However, I was quite disappointed with the behaviour of the female staff members.

While we were looking around the store, they kept watching us and following us wherever we went, which made us feel extremely uncomfortable. It felt as though we were being treated with suspicion, almost as if we were there to steal something.

I understand that staff need to be attentive, but customers should also be treated with basic respect and trust. Although I did purchase a few dresses that day, the experience left a very negative impression on me, and I have decided not to shop there again in the future.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and works on creating a more comfortable and welcoming environment for customers.
